_measured: 2026-09-16 against deno 2.9.6, 228 entrypoints, --node-modules-dir=none; generate-monthly-awards removed by MP-544 (the two TS2551 were a REAL runtime break, not a type nit -- see its index.ts); applicant-checkin removed by MP-547 -- its TS2551 was ALSO a real runtime break: .catch() on a lazy PostgrestFilterBuilder threw before .then() fired, so the manager-task insert was never sent and the applicant got a 500 after their check-in had committed. Two for two: every TS2551 'Property does not exist' in this baseline that has been read turned out to be live, not cosmetic. create-lead-checkout removed by MP-548 -- its TS2339 was a THIRD real runtime break, and the worst of the three: `v.enum(TIERS).optional()` sat at MODULE scope, so the TypeError fired at import and the worker never booted. Live-proven: POST and OPTIONS both returned 500 WORKER_ERROR while sibling functions sharing the same _shared/ files answered 200/400. It never reached function_errors (258 rows, live) because logFunctionError runs INSIDE the handler that never loaded -- which is why 142 days passed with no alert. Three for three: every 'property does not exist' entry in this baseline that has been read was live, not cosmetic. notify-deal-alert, notify-notes-added and verify-nipr removed by MP-549 -- and these were NOT runtime breaks, which is the point: all four of their errors (2x TS18048, 2x TS2345) came from ONE declaration, v.string() typing its result `string | undefined` no matter what `required` said, while the runtime threw. verify-nipr's pair was niprNumber + state, both required:true, so it never belonged to the TS2345 'SupabaseClient generic variance' cluster it was filed under. Nothing in prod changed; the checker stopped lying. The inverse direction was swept: all 5 genuinely-optional v.string fields are correctly guarded at their use sites. Removing these three is what now GRADES this class -- dropping `required: true` from a live schema whose field is used unguarded makes that slug a regression instead of a baselined error. seminar-confirmation removed by MP-550 -- and its TS2353 was the opposite of the three TS2551/TS2339 entries before it: the flagged `content_type` field is CORRECT and load-bearing, and nothing discarded it. resend@2.0.0's Attachment type simply predates the field. Verified both layers rather than assumed: the SDK's Emails.create() posts `JSON.stringify(payload)` with no allowlist, and a probe send read back from the DELIVERED MIME as `Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8; method=REQUEST`. The field is now declared through a named type instead of silenced with a cast, so a typo in it is still a compile error. The type error was a footnote; reading the slug is what found the real bug, which the checker could not see at all -- `btoa(icsBody)` threw InvalidCharacterError on a U+2014 em-dash hardcoded in the event title, uncaught, on EVERY invocation since the function shipped. 825 applications, 0 stamped rows, no receipt anywhere.
_rule: This is a SET, not a count. Any failing slug absent from it is a regression. Any slug here that now PASSES must be deleted from it — the set may only shrink.
